scientific_integrity: Exact analytic equilibrium and two-road cost statements are supported by a strict-potential proof and a reproducible finite exact-rational checker; the finite checks are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Static homogeneous two-class demand on finite positive-slope affine parallel links, with no capacities; novelty assessment is literature-limited; no field or noisy-data claims.
title: Exact demand symmetrization of selfish and fleet-optimal traffic on affine parallel roads
